title: Workflows
subtitle: Turn a repeatable process into a clear, reliable workflow.
scope: Start manually, read a deal and create follow-up tasks. More actions are on the roadmap.
name: Workflow name
emptyHint: Start with a follow-up template, then make it yours.
pauseHint: Pausing prevents new runs. Runs already queued continue.
subject: Follow up with the customer
dealTitle: Deal title from the previous step
triggerHint: Choose a deal when you start a run. This workflow never runs automatically.
readHint: Reads the chosen deal using the permissions of the person starting the run.
taskHint: Creates an undated task, assigned to the person running this workflow and linked to the chosen deal.
configureHint: Choose a step to configure its details.
simulationHint: Simulation validates the published workflow without keeping task changes.
liveHint: This creates real tasks. Check the selected deal before starting.
publishedHint: Runs use the published version. Save and publish your changes to include them.
queuedHint: Queued for the background worker. Processing may take up to a minute.
historyHint: Simulate a published version before running it on customer data.
loadError: The workflows could not be loaded.
denied: You do not have access to workflows. Ask an administrator to review your permissions.
error: The change could not be completed. Try again.
conflict: This workflow changed in another window. Your draft is still here. Reload after saving a copy of your changes.
invalid: Check the workflow configuration before publishing.
issue: Check this step’s inputs and connections.
notReady: This workflow contains an action that is not available yet.
bindingMissing: A required value was not available. Check the step’s field mapping.
runError: This run stopped before completion. Review its configuration and permissions.
nodeDescription: Press Enter to select a step.
